facts.value: The books face outwards by their fore-edges, not their spines, so a book can be lifted down and opened without tangling its chain.
facts.quote: The books are shelved with their foredges, rather than their spines, facing the reader (the wrong way round to us)
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.herefordcathedral.org/chained-library' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'foredges, rather than their spines, facing the reader'

facts.value: The Mappa Mundi carries about 500 drawings, among them around 420 cities and towns and 33 plants, animals, birds and strange creatures.
facts.quote: These 500 or so drawings include of around 420 cities and towns, 15 Biblical events, 33 plants, animals, birds and strange creatures
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.herefordcathedral.org/mappa-mundi' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'around 420 cities and towns'

facts.value: In the Civil War siege of Hereford the dean preached against Parliamentary soldiers' desecration of the cathedral. They threatened to shoot him until their colonel stopped them.
facts.quote: Dean Herbert Croft preaches against the desecration of the cathedral by the Parliamentary soldiers, who threaten to shoot him, but are prevented by their commander, Colonel Birch
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.herefordcathedral.org/our-history' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'who threaten to shoot him, but are prevented by their commander, Colonel Birch'

facts.value: In 2007 the Mappa Mundi became the UK's second entry on the UNESCO Memory of the World register.
facts.quote: In 2007 it became the United Kingdom’s second entry on the UNESCO’s Memory of the World register
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://www.herefordcathedral.org/our-history' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'it became the United Kingdom'
